name: Fun Text
author: Slashbar
description: Playful text transforms — AI and local shell mixed

commands.name: Explain Like I'm Five
commands.body: Explain the following to a five-year-old, using simple words and a friendly analogy. Keep it short. Answer in the same language as the input.
commands.description: Simplify anything down to child level.

commands.name: Emojify
commands.body: Rewrite the following text, sprinkling in fitting emojis generously. Keep the meaning intact. Return only the rewritten text.

commands.name: Roast My Code
commands.body: Roast the following code: point out its problems with humor, then end with two genuinely useful improvement suggestions.

commands.name: ROT13
commands.description: Classic letter-rotation cipher (run twice to decode).
